opus.problem: The cited verse (1 Kings 18:35) only says the water ran down around the altar and filled the trench. It does not say that Elijah had water poured. That detail comes from 1 Kings 18:33-34, so the clue is not fully supported by its reference. Widen the reference to 1 Kings 18:33-35 or cut the clue to what verse 35 says.
